_about: Sixty gold questions for the BinaSmart business-life knowledge pack, 40 Amharic and 20 English. Built by ops/packs/build-gold.js --pack business into /root/storage/bina-embed/eval/gold-business.json. A question may not enter the set unless the page it names is on disk, is live and actually discusses its subject: at least three English content words of `topic` must appear in the page text, and a `topicAm` is required as well wherever the gold page is itself Amharic. One unverifiable question and NOTHING is written. Every question here was written from what the pages were measured to contain after the Task 5 fetch, never from what a ministry might plausibly publish. The four people of design section 1 - the shopkeeper, the importer, the founder and the employer - each have a share. THE PACK IS 97 ENGLISH DOCUMENTS AND 16 AMHARIC ONES, so 16 of the 40 Amharic questions are deliberately cross-lingual: they ask in Amharic about an institution that publishes only in English (eic, ipdc, eccsa, aaccsa, and the mols overseas-employment register). The plan was written expecting more Amharic pages than the fetch produced; the questions were not moved onto Amharic pages to flatter the number, because the design's target is per language slice and the split is what the number means. Amharic labels are placed where Amharic pages exist: the etrade service catalogue and FAQ, the eight motri /am pages, the four poessa pages and the mols /am profile.

measured.note: Measured against the pack as it stands on 2026-09-18: 113 documents, 97 English and 16 Amharic. 24 of the 40 Amharic questions land on an Amharic page and 16 cannot, because the institution that answers them publishes only in English. The banking pack measured 86.2 percent when a question and its page share a language and 43.8 percent when they do not, a gap of more than 40 points, so this 24/16 split predicts the whole-set score better than anything else here. motri, poessa, etrade and the mols /am profile are the only sources in this pack with Amharic pages; eic, ipdc, eccsa, aaccsa and the mols agency register are English and depend entirely on ops/packs/am-headers.js for their Amharic titles and key facts.

coverage_gaps: Fees for trade registration and licensing: motri publishes requirements and prints `Processing Time: Online` for every service, and no fee figure at all. etrade says a payment order arrives by SMS after approval and can be settled at any commercial bank, but publishes no schedule of amounts. No question in this set asks what a trade licence costs, because no page in the pack answers it.
Processing times: same cause. `Online` is the only answer motri gives, so no question asks how many days a registration takes.

Customs procedure: ecc.gov.et timed out on every path from the VPS and from the laptop, so declaration, clearance, duty bands and franco valuta have no first-party page in this pack. The eic FAQ's customs-duty band (0-35 percent) is the Commission restating the tariff, not the Commission's own counter.
Intellectual property: eipo.gov.et timed out from both machines, so trademark and patent registration has no first-party source and no question.
21 motri PDFs are scans that pdftotext returned zero characters for; they are in /root/storage/packs/business-manual and are not documents of this pack, so nothing here is asked of them.
47 mols pages came back empty or below the 400-character floor and were not written, which is why the only mols documents are the profile, the /am profile and the two-part agency register.
eic-investment-process is lorem ipsum on the Commission's own site. It is on disk because it is live, and it is never a label.
